about_subtitle: Creative Laboratory for Sound and Image
about_body: Founded in 2009 in Bogotá by Diego Díaz and Leonard Jaramillo, Willow Tree was born as a creative laboratory where sound and image become languages to move, inspire, and transcend. More than a studio, we are a space where artistic passion and technical precision grow together, giving life to unique experiences that blend music, audiovisual production, and storytelling with our distinctive signature. In every project, we cultivate creativity like a tree: from the seed of an idea to a complete universe, true to our motto “Ideas that become worlds.”
contact_dossier_body: Download our complete dossier to learn more about our projects, methodologies, and rates. If you need a personalized quote or have a project in mind, contact us directly.
clients_subtitle: We have transformed the sonic and visual identity of these brands
clients_body: The trust of our clients is the strongest testimony to our commitment to excellence. We have collaborated with a diverse range of brands, artists, and agencies, helping them tell their stories in an impactful way through audio, video, and transmedia experiences. Join our list of satisfied collaborators.
developed_by: Developed by 4 of Willow Tree Media ®
service_audio_prod_copy: Integral development of musical projects, from composition and arrangements to final delivery, preserving the sonic identity of each artist or brand.
portfolio_audio_prod_desc_title: Original Music for Artists and Brands
portfolio_audio_prod_desc_body: At Willow Tree, we conceive music as the heart of every project. Our Music Production portfolio covers everything from creating original soundtracks, commercial jingles, and 'sonic branding', to the complete production of albums for artists. We blend our passion for sound with technical precision to ensure every note resonates with your project's identity and message. We explore genres and styles, always striving for the highest artistic and sonic quality.
service_audio_rec_copy: Studios equipped with state-of-the-art technology to capture voices, instruments, and ambiances with the highest fidelity and character.
portfolio_audio_rec_desc_title: Recording Studios: Willow Tree x Basswalk
portfolio_audio_rec_desc_body:
The alliance between Willow Tree and Basswalk Studios creates an ideal space for musical and audiovisual production, combining technical excellence and comfort. Artists and creators can record with advanced technology and varied instruments in an environment that inspires freedom and enhances creativity.

**Microphones**
* AKG C414 XLII – multi-pattern reference condenser.
* Shure SM57 – standard for instruments and snares.
* Shure SM58 Wireless – professional wireless vocal system.
* Electro-Voice RE20 – classic studio dynamic microphone.
* Drum microphone kit – Sennheiser e600 Drum Pack (e602-II, e604, e614).
* And a wide additional collection of condenser, ribbon, and dynamic microphones.

**Instruments**
* Alesis Strike Pro SE electronic drum kit.
* Pearl Masters Maple Complete acoustic drum kit.
* Percussion: LP Galaxy Giovanni congas, Meinl bongos, marimbas, lyres, Tibetan singing bowls, and assorted ethnic accessories.
* Guitars: Fender Stratocaster American Professional, Gibson Les Paul Standard 60s, PRS Custom 24, Ibanez RG Prestige.
* Basses: Fender Jazz Bass American Ultra, Music Man StingRay Special.

**Audio Gear**
* Pro Tools HD as the main recording and mixing system.
* Analog Mastering with: Manley Massive Passive EQ, Shadow Hills Mastering Compressor, Empirical Labs Distressor EL8X.
* Avalon VT-737sp Channel Strip.
* Universal Audio Apollo x8p for interface and conversion.
* Virtual instrument suites: Native Instruments Komplete 14, Spectrasonics Omnisphere, Arturia V Collection, U-He Diva, and more.
service_audio_mix_copy: Sonic balance, spatiality, and creative treatment to bring recordings to their maximum aesthetic potential.
portfolio_audio_mix_desc_body: The process that brings your music to life, transforming individual tracks into a unified sonic experience. We work on stereo panorama, dynamics, and creative effects usage.
portfolio_audio_master_copy: The final step: optimizing sound for distribution on digital platforms, CD, and vinyl, ensuring consistency and global loudness.
portfolio_audio_master_desc_body: The final polish that prepares your music for the world. We ensure the music sounds optimally on any playback system, meeting the volume and quality standards of modern platforms.
service_audio_jingles_copy: We create the 'sonic branding' your brand needs, from memorable jingles to a complete sound strategy. We use real voices and cutting-edge AI.
portfolio_audio_jingles_desc_title: Creation of Sonic Identity and 'Sonic Branding'
portfolio_audio_jingles_desc_body: We create music and sound that defines and enhances your brand. Our Jingles and Sonic Identity service covers everything from composing memorable short pieces to designing a complete 'sonic branding' strategy. We use real voices from our roster of talent and support ourselves with **cutting-edge artificial intelligence** to optimize creative flows, ensuring a unique and high-impact sound that resonates with your audience. * Let's work together on your brand's voice!
service_audio_cinetv_copy: Custom music for film, television, theatre, video games, and transmedia experiences, adapted to the emotion and style of each project.
portfolio_audio_cinetv_desc_title: Original Scores for Film and Television
portfolio_audio_cinetv_desc_body: Music is the soul of narrative. We specialize in creating original soundtracks that seamlessly integrate with the image, reinforcing the emotion and intent of each scene. We work closely with directors and producers to translate their vision into unforgettable cinematic scores, from large orchestrations to minimalist sound designs. * Call us to give your story the sound it deserves!
service_audio_voice_copy: Directing and recording professional voices for advertising, dubbing, narration, and audiovisual projects in an optimized studio.
portfolio_audio_voice_desc_body: From talent selection to post-production, we guarantee the perfect voice for your project. We offer voice talent direction, dialogue recording, narrations for audiobooks, podcasts, and full dubbing and voice-over services. Our studio is acoustically optimized for capturing voice with maximum purity. * Ask us about our catalog of professional voices!
service_audio_games_copy: Composition and production in ambisonic and spatial formats, designed to create immersive experiences that envelop the player and enhance interactive narrative.
portfolio_audio_games_desc_title: Interactive Audio and Spatial Sound for Games
portfolio_audio_games_desc_body: Video game sound is our playground. We create dynamic music (Wwise/FMOD ready) and sound design that reacts to gameplay. We specialize in implementing spatial audio, achieving 3D soundscapes that completely immerse the player in the experience. * Boost your game's immersion with our interactive audio!
service_video_prod_copy: Integral production of audiovisual projects, from script to final delivery for TV, cinema, and digital platforms.
portfolio_video_prod_desc_body: We are a full team ready to bring your vision to life. We handle all phases of production: pre-production, direction, lighting, filming with cinematic equipment, and direct sound. Our experience ensures that every frame captures the emotion and story you want to convey.
service_video_post_prod_copy: Professional video editing, color correction (grading), sound design, and mixing to ensure the highest technical and artistic quality.
portfolio_video_post_prod_desc_title: Editing, Color Grading, and Sound Design
portfolio_video_post_prod_desc_body: Post-production is the final touch. We offer agile editing services, advanced color correction (DaVinci Resolve) to achieve the desired 'look', and immersive sound design, perfectly synchronizing audio and video.
service_video_anim_copy: Creation of 2D and 3D animation, Motion Graphics for advertising, explainer videos, and animated infographics with visual impact.
portfolio_video_anim_desc_body: We turn complex ideas into dynamic visual narratives. Whether it's traditional animation, 3D rendering, or motion graphics for social media, our team creates pieces that capture attention and explain concepts with clarity and style.
service_video_3d_copy: 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, and photorealistic rendering services for products, architecture, and video game environments.
portfolio_video_3d_desc_body: We build worlds and objects in three dimensions with a high level of detail. From architectural visualizations and product prototypes to assets ready for video game engines (Unity/Unreal). Precision is our foundation, creativity our engine.
service_video_product_copy: Short, striking videos designed specifically to boost sales and highlight features on e-commerce platforms and advertising.
portfolio_video_product_desc_body: Video is key to e-commerce. We produce product videos with high visual quality, focused on detail and functionality, optimized for conversions on Amazon, Shopify, or social media ads. We turn features into visual benefits.
service_video_social_copy: Creación de contenido vertical y horizontal optimizado para engagement en TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts y otras plataformas.
portfolio_video_social_desc_title: Estrategia y Contenido de Video para Plataformas Sociales
portfolio_video_social_desc_body: Entendemos el lenguaje de las redes. Producimos contenido de video rápido, impactante y relevante, maximizando el engagement y la viralidad. Nuestra estrategia incluye la adaptación a formatos verticales, subtitulado dinámico y optimización para el algoritmo de cada plataforma.
